summary: County page, MyCountyParks park and site pages: 25 electric/water sites $25 walk-up, 4 reservable at $30 (5 days ahead), 12 primitive $15, modern restrooms, shower house, dump, 14-day limit. Fee range corrected 15-25 -> 25-30 (base excludes primitive). Phone found. Not waterfront kept, with an upward lead.
flags: PHONE: none stored. Park ranger / campground host cell 563-357-4134 (county brochure and the MyCountyParks site page: 'park supervisor at 563-357-4134. Texts or voicemails are acceptable'); Board office 563-847-7202. Suggest 563-357-4134.

WATERFRONT LEAD (up, unconfirmed): MyCountyParks says 'grab a modern water/electric site (WiFi included!) along the bank of the river', which differs from the stored not waterfront, so re-audited. The stored evidence ('loop 80-100 m north of the Wapsipinicon') measured from the main loop; imagery also shows electric sites off the lane running east from the loop parallel to the river, the south-side ones ~15-35 m from the bank. The river is ~45-90 m wide with sandbars (riverfront size). Both NAIP and Esri show a band of trees along the bank in front of those sites, and the county's summer gallery photo (mowed grass to the bank under big trees) is not tied to a site. Kept not waterfront; a site photo from the east lane would settle riverview vs riverfront.

FEES: three county statements disagree on the walk-up rate: county page and MyCountyParks park page $25, MyCountyParks Activity page 'Electrical/Water Sites $20/night, $30.00/night for reservable sites'. Used $25 (two sources, one the county's own). Stored note '25 electric $25, 12 primitive $15' matches; the IE's $17/$12 is out of date.

SITE COUNT: county 25 electric; the MyCountyParks site page says 'Four of the 26 water/electrical sites'; the park page says '3 sites available' reservable while 4 reservable campsite facilities are listed (8 ADA, 16, 17, 18).
SEASON: MyCountyParks 'Operating Hours & Seasons: Open April 1st through October 31st.' is a park statement, not a campground one, so season left unset.
